# BThwani DSH UI Kit Golden Slice

## Activation
Use when the task mentions DSH, delivery, client/partner/captain/field, control panel delivery operations, service-owned UI, or DSH UI-kit closure.

## Golden slice surfaces

```text
app-client/runtime
app-partner/runtime
app-captain/runtime
app-field/runtime
control-panel/runtime
dsh
ui-kit
```

## Closure order

1. Confirm owner path from the current repo.
2. Confirm whether work is UI/UX/Flow only or includes binding/integration.
3. Enforce UI kit public export usage.
4. Verify RTL and BThwani brand.
5. Produce Git and visual evidence.

## Forbidden

- spreading DSH UI patterns into local app-only design systems
- mixing DSH UI closure with backend/API work unless requested
- declaring 100% closure without matrix/evidence
- adding one-off colors or local components when ui-kit should own them
